title: LOOKUPVALUE returns the alternate result when the matching rows have different result values

source.quote: if result_columnName returns different values, the function returns an error or alternateResult (if specified)
source.supports: an error or the alternate result, if specified

source.quote: if Result_Column returns different values, the function returns Alternate_Result if defined, otherwise it returns an error

derivation: Bike and Helmet are both Red, with different Product values. The alternate result "several" is returned instead of an error.
